reaching the cap is charged the full cap. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until

def draw(panel_top,panel_bottom,edge,fill,templates):
    height=panel_bottom-panel_top+1
    for x,shape in templates:
        sy=panel_bottom-len(shape)+1
        # For each source pixel, the color matching panel fill maps to edge;
        # the other source color maps to panel fill.
        colors=set(v for row in shape for v in row)
        assert fill in colors
        other=next(v for v in colors if v!=fill)
        for i,row in enumerate(shape):
            for j,v in enumerate(row):
                grid[sy+i][x+j] = edge if v==fill else fill
# P1 uses fill color 4; P2 uses fill color 6
